outputs.visual_description_en: The image is a digital graphic with an orange header and white background. The header contains the text "□□ बड़ी खुशखबरी □□" (Big Good News). The main body of the text, in Hindi, announces the "प्रधानमंत्री मुफ्त लैपटॉप योजना 2026" (Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026), stating that the government is providing free laptops to all students. It also mentions an application deadline of "15 अक्टूबर" (October 15) and instructs users to click on a link to register their names. A blue URL, "www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in", is prominently displayed. The image concludes with a red instruction to "इसे सभी ग्रुप में फॉरवर्ड करें" (Forward this to all groups).
